Our Story

About Bunz

Fresh, tasty and made with love — right here in Kigali, Rwanda.

🔥Fresh & Tasty

We Are Bunz

Bunz is Kigali's go-to spot for fresh, flavour-packed food. Located at the KBC Building in Kicukiro, we've been serving the Kigali community with honest, delicious food made from scratch every single day.

From our signature salad bowls topped with boiled eggs, grapes and cashews, to our loaded subs packed with melted cheddar and savory meats — every item is crafted with care. Our motto? Fresh & Tasty.

We partner with local suppliers to keep ingredients fresh, and our passionate team makes sure every order leaves the kitchen looking and tasting amazing. Come through — you won't regret it! 🍔
